name: run-status-lifecycle-transition
reason: Workflow Run status progression (accepted->queued->running, active->blocked) must go through the validated lifecycle machine, not ad-hoc status writes (NIN-109/197).

name: run-status-inbound-parse
reason: Inbound external status strings must be parsed into a Run Status so a Workflow State value is never accepted as a Run Status (NIN-109/197/270).

name: evidence-show
reason: `run evidence show <id>` reads evidence through readEvidenceForDisplay, redacting secret-classified fields on display while preserving the raw stored record (NIN-108/204).

name: http-run-create-drive
reason: Every intake surface emits workflow_run.accepted; the Phase-8 acceptedRunDriver subscriber (cli/services.ts) drives the accepted run through driveAcceptedWorkflowRun -> executeWorkflowDefinition, so an HTTP-created run is not just an intake record (NIN-110/203).

name: workflow-level-status-mapping
reason: completion-writeback resolves the run's workflow-level statusMapping from the archive (cli/services.ts) and threads it as workflowMapping into mirrorWorkflowRunStatusToTracker, so a workflow definition's override beats the workspace-level board mapping end-to-end (NIN-77/270).

name: tracker-polling-reconcile
reason: The orchestrator poll tick drives each polled tracker issue through acceptTrackerIssueWorkflowRun (cli/services.ts pollTrackerIssue) on the same intake idempotency path as the webhook leg, so webhook delivery + polling reconciliation for one external issue collapse to a single Workflow Run (NIN-106).

name: verifier-decision-routing
reason: The executor routes the verifier verdict through routeSingleVerifierDecision/resolveVerifierStep on the CLI-driven run path: not_satisfied with retry budget remaining loops back to the implementer state instead of blocking, and the allowlist-filtered verifier input is consumed; the live real-verifier exercise is carried to NIN-273/76 (NIN-102/201).

name: intake-rule-evaluation
reason: Production intake call sites now load real intake rules from config (cli loadCliIntakeRules; http deps.intakeRules) and thread them through intake-core into resolveWorkflowRunIntake, so ambiguous intake is rejected with a disambiguation error, invalid intake is rejected before any run record is created, and an explicit retry signal resumes the existing run instead of duplicating it (NIN-107/202).
